homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field, and no card is a homonym: every card concerns the index, its brief, its makers' pages or commentary on it. 'Generative AI and Jobs' is also the head of the 2023 paper's title (card 6); the 2023 index is the entity's predecessor, a distinct entity, never a sense of the name.

captures.q: ILO Generative AI and Jobs index
captures.description: THE ILO GENERATIVE AI AND JOBS INDEX, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'The International Labour Organization (ILO) published its updated assessment in the report "Generative AI and Jobs: A Refined Global Index of Occupational Exposure" (ILO Working Paper 140).' Seven findings (24% of workers exposed; 3.3% in the highest gradient; transformation over replacement; 34% in high-income against 11% in low-income countries; women nearly twice as exposed as men, 'roughly 29% vs. 16%'; the most and least exposed occupations) and the method (task data points, four gradients). Eight cards, two of them the ILO's.

atoms.evidence: Generative AI and Jobs: A Refined Global Index of Occupational Exposure
The International Labour Organization (ILO) published its updated assessment in the report
Transformation vs. Replacement: The research emphasizes job transformation rather than widespread job elimination or mass redundancy, as very few occupations consist entirely of automatable tasks.
